figures.finding: No Monegasque agreement sets a performer's pay, but Monaco's wage law sets every employee's minimum at no less than what regulation or collective agreements give the same profession in Nice (or else the Alpes-Maritimes), raised by a 5% allowance: a performer employed in Monaco is owed at least the French minimum that applies in Nice, plus 5%.

value.rule: Monaco's minimum pay for an employee equals the minimum set by regulation or collective agreement for the same profession in Nice (or else the Alpes-Maritimes), plus a 5% exceptional allowance
